race.comment: Terrific race as always. BALASTIER (3) is a former Victorian who is unbeaten in two NT starts for the new yard, virtually leading throughout at each to score. Won by a space last time and is the one to run down again. Similarly, RUNAWAY TYCOON (12) has been hard to fault for the new yard, placing at first run then winning three on end. Has pace and expected to go close. FIELD OF FLUTES (5) was well off best last time and is better than that. Better draw and worth another try. The bonny mare DAKOTA LEE (1) is three weeks between runs and coming back in journey. Tough as nails though, goes forward and doesn't lay down. No surprise to see her back in winning form. FLYING YISHU (6) has been freshened and looks next best.
